newsitem.title: HUNGARY: FOTEX LEAPS BUT SEEMS SETTLING DOWN.
newsitem.headline: FOTEX LEAPS BUT SEEMS SETTLING DOWN.

text.p: Shares in Hungarian retailer Fotex Rt leapt more than 12 percent in early trading on Wednesday but traders said the share price seemed to settle at around 250 forints, the highest level since early 1996.
At 1011 GMT Fotex shares traded at 244 forints, up 22 forints or 9.91 percent from Tuesday's close.
"The paper has one foreign buyer, the same one who bought it when it was 200 forints," one trader said.
The trader added the buyer was not Fotex's biggest single shareholder, Panama-based Blackburn International Inc, but said he did not know who the buyer was.
Blackburn has announced several purchases this month of Fotex shares of amounts between 10,000 and 27,000 units.
